notes:
Shorthand CRM notes and call highlights:
- Customer: mid-market e-comm with personalized shopping assistant roadmap.
- Primary need: conversational support + product re-rank for recommendations. Tight latency budgets (p95 < 250ms for agent responses).
- Cost sensitivity: wants predictable unit-costs; disliked opaque GPU pricing.
- Security: must have SOC2 + audit logs; strong preference for data residency in US.
- Quote from head of infra: "We can prototype quickly on OpenAI, fewer hoops."
- SE feedback: Redwood's dedicated offering met most requirements but onboarding + contract length were concerns.
- Key stall: internal reorg removed the original champion (Sr. PM left), procurement defaulted to lowest-friction path.
- Action: paused. Add to Q4 re-engage queue and send 1-pager vs OpenAI differentiators (cost predictability, can run in VPC/Dedicated, stronger routing/fallback controls).
use_case_summary: Wanted an omnichannel support agent + personalized recommendations pipeline. Expected throughput: 120 requests/min peak, latency target p95 <= 250ms for chat, embedding batch throughput for nightly re-ranks. Required SSO + audit logs. Favored simple hosted API during evaluation but also explored Dedicated for traffic predictability.
loss_reason_detail: Customer chose OpenAI/Anthropic direct APIs for perceived simplicity and brand familiarity; also internal budget freeze and loss of champion after reorg. Procurement cited faster time-to-live and existing credits. Security team accepted direct SaaS model for now — but noted missing enterprise SLA for data residency.
